name: Mandarin Oriental, Marrakech
insider_take: Where ancient Moroccan artisanship meets world-class luxury in a breathtaking oasis beneath the Atlas Mountains.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on 20 hectares of fragrant gardens and olive groves, featuring traditional Moroccan architecture with hand-carved zellige tiles and intricate plasterwork. The property boasts the largest spa in Marrakech and offers unparalleled views of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. Each villa and suite features private gardens or terraces, while the resort's seven pools create a serene sanctuary just minutes from the bustling medina.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise hot air balloon ride over the Atlas Mountains - the hotel can arrange exclusive departures that include champagne breakfast upon landing back at the property.
dont_miss: The resort's signature hammam experience using traditional Moroccan black soap and argan oil, dining at Mes'Lalla for authentic tagines with mountain views, and exploring the nearby Ourika Valley's Berber villages - accessible via the hotel's private 4WD excursions through dramatic mountain terrain.
pros: Exceptional luxury service with signature Mandarin Oriental hospitality standards
Stunning traditional Moroccan architecture with modern amenities
World-class spa offering authentic Moroccan wellness treatments
Prime location with easy access to Marrakech's historic medina and attractions
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
